name: Fitness Tracker
highLevelGoals: The Fitness Enthusiast aims to meticulously track and analyze advanced performance metrics from their physical activities to gain deeper insights into their training and optimize their performance.
The Fitness Enthusiast seeks to set challenging fitness goals and effectively monitor their progress towards achieving and surpassing these targets, driving continuous improvement.
The Fitness Enthusiast desires personalized workout recommendations that adapt to their evolving fitness level and specific goals, ensuring efficient and effective training.
The Beginner User aims to easily record and monitor all their physical activities, both automatically and manually, to establish consistent exercise habits.
The Beginner User seeks clear visual representations of their fitness progress and timely notifications of achievements to maintain motivation and understand their improvements.
The Beginner User wants to set realistic and adjustable fitness goals to provide direction and a sense of accomplishment, fostering a sustainable fitness journey.
The Beginner User desires personalized workout recommendations that guide them through suitable exercises and adapt to their feedback, helping them progress safely and effectively.
The Wearable Device User aims to effortlessly connect their wearable devices to the application to automatically sync and consolidate all their fitness data in one place.
The Wearable Device User seeks to receive real-time and accurate fitness metrics from their wearable device within the application, ensuring up-to-date insights into their performance.
The Social Sharer aims to easily post their completed activities and fitness milestones on social media platforms to celebrate their progress and connect with their network.
The Social Sharer seeks to use social media sharing features to inspire friends and family, receive support, and foster a sense of community around their fitness journey.
lowLevelGoals: The system should allow the Fitness Enthusiast to retrieve their heart rate variability (HRV) data for a specified period.
The system should display a graphical representation of the Fitness Enthusiast's VO2 max trends over time.
The system should calculate and display a training load score based on the Fitness Enthusiast's recent activities.
The system should allow the Fitness Enthusiast to set a new personal record target for a specific activity type (e.g., fastest 5k run).
The system should display the Fitness Enthusiast's progress towards a specific strength goal (e.g., 1-rep max for a lift).
The system should send a notification to the Fitness Enthusiast when a personal fitness goal is achieved or surpassed.
The system should generate a workout plan tailored to the Fitness Enthusiast's current fitness level and specified target (e.g., marathon training).
The system should allow the Fitness Enthusiast to adjust the intensity of their current workout plan based on their feedback.
The system should suggest alternative exercises for a specific workout within the Fitness Enthusiast's plan.
The system should allow the Beginner User to manually log details of a completed physical activity, including type, duration, and perceived effort.
The system should automatically detect and record a walking session based on device sensor data for the Beginner User.
The system should allow the Beginner User to edit the details of a previously logged activity.
The system should display a chart summarizing the Beginner User's activity duration and calorie burn for the current week.
The system should send a notification to the Beginner User when they maintain an activity streak for a specified number of days.
The system should visually indicate the Beginner User's progress towards their daily step goal.
The system should allow the Beginner User to set a new daily step goal.
The system should allow the Beginner User to modify an existing weekly activity goal (e.g., increase target workout minutes).
The system should award and display a virtual badge to the Beginner User upon successful completion of a set fitness goal.
The system should suggest a beginner-friendly cardio workout based on the Beginner User's profile.
The system should provide clear, step-by-step instructions and visual aids for each exercise in a suggested workout for the Beginner User.
The system should adjust the difficulty of subsequent workout suggestions based on the Beginner User's feedback (e.g., 'too easy', 'too hard').
The system should allow the Wearable Device User to connect a new wearable fitness device (e.g., Fitbit, Apple Watch) to the application.
The system should allow the Wearable Device User to manually initiate a data synchronization from their connected wearable device.
The system should display the current connection status (e.g., 'connected', 'disconnected') of the Wearable Device User's wearable device.
The system should display the Wearable Device User's real-time heart rate data streamed from their connected wearable device.
The system should display the Wearable Device User's live step count as reported by their wearable device.
The system should update the estimated calorie burn in real-time during an ongoing activity, based on data from the Wearable Device User's wearable.
The system should allow the Social Sharer to share details of a completed workout directly to their Facebook feed.
The system should allow the Social Sharer to post a fitness milestone (e.g., '100km walked') as an image to Instagram.
The system should allow the Social Sharer to customize the message accompanying their shared fitness achievement before posting.
The system should display notifications to the Social Sharer when their shared fitness posts receive likes or comments on integrated social media platforms.
The system should allow the Social Sharer to view a friend's shared fitness activity within the application or via a link to the social media platform.
The system should allow the Social Sharer to tag friends in their shared fitness achievements on social media platforms.
